title: Triapsidal Triclinium conservation shelter, Villa Romana del Casale
visualBrief: Detached triapsidal Triclinium conservation shelter only. Exact mapped west rectangle and three rounded apses, low stone ruin plinth, glazed exterior proxies between slim frame posts, pale faceted hipped central roof/three radial apse caps, raised roof ribs and diagonal bracing. West entrance has a shallow recess, soffit, threshold and three short reconstructed treads. Main villa/baths, Xystus court, gate piers and two latrines remain independent. Generic interior floor is not a reproduction of figurative mosaics; no copied artwork, furniture or archaeological room inventory.

Native east/up/south axes are baked, heading0. Only this footprint is replaced; all other site structures remain independent.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Photo-led medium-fi conservation exterior. Ordinary aerial shows a pale translucent framed central shelter and three radial apse caps. No qualified mapped heights. Working floor 546.116m absolute follows the native west threshold plus0.36m. Ruin base1.0m, canopy eave5.2m, central peak7.6m and apse peaks7.4m above the floor are reconstructed. Opaque pale glazing/roof proxies retain simple reflections without costly refraction. Frame spacing, doorway/stairs, roof junctions, unseen elevations, actual floor/mosaic state and accessibility are unverified.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Qualified approximate native conservation exterior fit on original Protomaps20261020/Mapzen 201x201/6m terrain.
